notes.title: Locked keys
notes.content:
Dear friends! 

Because of the conflict with the store "Otaku" we have blocked all the keys and return the old keys can not. All this week we have been thinking about the solution to the situation. Those who had their keys revoked as: [b]Typical Nightmare, Outside and Not my day[/b]. 
Please see the application form at email: [u]EvilGamesStudios@yandex.ru[/u]. 

The application form should consist of the following: 
Message subject: Locked keys 
In a message to paint the points: 
1. What games were blocked and their number 
([u]for example, Typical Nightmare-1 key[/u]) 
2. Proof that your key is locked 
([u]a photo or a message from steam locked games[/u]) 
3. Attach a receipt for the purchase of the game 
([u]if you do not have a check, the application will be considered longer[/u]) 
To speed up the application process, please provide more information about the purchase. 

Response time may take some time. [u]Please do not flood in the comments[/u]. The application form is mandatory. 
[b]The application is accepted only by mail![/b] 

With respect ElectroStalin Entertainment!

notes.title: Final update of early access
notes.content:
Dear friends, we want to inform you that this update will be [u]the last[/u] for this card, since our team is preparing the final, full game changing, update, release.
[h1]What we are preparing for you on this update: [/h1]

[b]- New map (completely changed setting and graphics, you will be transferred to the USSR pioneer camp)
- The plot company (we do not depart from the canon of the maniac, but we are engaged in its development, we will soon devote you to the case and launch a closed test)
- Cooperative story company
- Multiplayer mode (its modes and features we'll disclose a little later)
- Change of hero and villain (the hero and villain will be changed to the setting of the new card)[/b]
More detailed description of the update and screenshots, we will publish later.

[u]And now on the last update on this map. [/u]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155093/7ece58d85db018c82032376595d591a8ef9bcb72.png[/img]
[h1]Update v0.0.3[/h1]
[b]- Changing the map
- Adding language (ru)
- New places on the map
- Complicating the gameplay[/b]

This is where the changes in the update come to an end, in the future there will be fixes and small changes for requests in the steam community, but there will be no changes on the map any more.
[u]New Year's update will be removed at the end of this month.[/u]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155093/f9c3e38f9c609d70be4ac8962b2aba9320a209ed.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31155093/12c00f727dfc15fa5a0f5183ac5aeeaefc0e8e3f.jpg[/img][/url]

Thank you for your attention and enjoy the game!

[u]Sincerely, EvilGames [/u]

notes.content:
The update will be released before the first day.
Let's say a little about what will be included in the upcoming update:

-Processed map (The whole map will be processed in the winter version)
-Addition to the location (Church)
-The animals are processed
-Healers (Wolves)
-Weather effects

At the moment, this is all we can tell you!
Thank you for watching the game and Merry Christmas!
